items.claim: Tinara is mature for her age, well-rounded, and can compete in all aspects of MMA.
items.quote: what I've seen from Tinara is that she's mature for her age. She's well-rounded and she can take the fight anywhere.

items.claim: Amanda Lamos has one-hitter-quitter knockout power and is very strong.
items.quote: Amanda Lamos, what she's known for is she's one of the few women that's got that one hitter quitter knockout power. She's very strong.

items.claim: Amanda Lamos's historical weakness has been getting put on her back.
items.quote: Her weakness has always been if you can put her on her back.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a long body type and a diverse array of striking weapons including elbows, combinations, knees, kicks, and straight punches.
items.quote: Tai Miller kind of reminds me of like the new school Carlos Cond means hybrid. He's got that long body type. He's got all kinds of shots at his disposal. Elbows, combinations, knees, kicks, nice straight punches.

items.claim: Tai Miller has not shown cardio issues or falling off a cliff in fights.
items.quote: I haven't seen some kind of cardio issue from Tai Miller. I haven't seen this guy fall off a cliff.

items.claim: Adam Fugat was able to hurt Tai Miller in his previous fight.
items.quote: you saw in that last fight, Adam Fugat hurt this guy.

items.claim: Darren Elkins is 42 years old and this is his retirement fight.
items.quote: Elkins 12 years older at 42... everybody's heard this is Darren Elkins retirement fight.

items.claim: Isaac Dulgarian threw his fight against Yadier Delvi.
items.quote: It was Isaac Dulgaren that threw the fight.
